notes: Literature check ran in strict mode (8 of 12 queries; first query hit an arXiv HTTP 429 and was retried; benchmarks command found no external benchmark, so baseline scout was skipped). The baseline-scout requirement is hard to apply to papers with a self-defined evaluation and no external benchmark. The skill says every reviewer reads the redacted copy and the EIC restores flagged text, which is a no-op when the scan is clean. Pool-position guidance (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65) and the 'start weights at 1.0' rule were followed; the choice between pool 52 for the EIC and per-reviewer positions had no explicit script field (eic_pool_position is only in summary). The venue_recommendation label for ICLR printed two scales ('4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10} (5 on {1,3,5,6,8,10})'), so the label is ambiguous for an Overall of 3. Sandbox blocked inline JSON/braces in shell commands, so helper files were written inside the results directory (lit_helper.py, novelty_profile.json, fingerprint.json, reviewer_copy.txt). The five reviewers shared one context, so independence is imperfect (disclosed in review.md).
